title: Repair Signatory Ghost Ship scene import on Foundry V13

phases.title: Use Foundry V13-compatible wall threshold data
Recover a legacy managed scene created without walls

finalChecks.name: Ghost Ship wall thresholds are nullable, never zero
finalChecks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); if(!s.includes('threshold: { light: null, sight: null, sound: null, attenuation: false }')) throw new Error('nullable wall threshold tuple missing'); if(s.includes('threshold: { light: 0, sight: 0, sound: 0')) throw new Error('invalid zero wall thresholds remain');"

finalChecks.name: Manifest and Ghost Ship seed versions agree
finalChecks.run: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); const s=fs.readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); if(m.version!=='0.2.1') throw new Error('manifest version is not 0.2.1'); if(!s.includes('const MODULE_VERSION = \"0.2.1\";')) throw new Error('Ghost Ship seed version is not 0.2.1');"
